entries.name: StarVector (1B and 8B)

engines.name: Image encoder plus adapter plus code language model
engines.does: Turns image patches into visual tokens that a code LLM continues as SVG text.

capabilities.does: Reads a raster image and writes SVG source as text. Suited to icons, logos, technical diagrams and charts. The repo says it does not handle natural images or complex illustrations.
Writes a new SVG from a text instruction alone, using the same model.
Ships ten evaluation sets (SVG-Stack, Fonts, Emoji, Icons, Diagrams, FIGR and simplified variants) for scoring SVG generators with image-similarity metrics.

model.weights_licence: Apache-2.0 on both HF checkpoints; base-model and training-data licences not stated on the card
model.commercial_notes: The card says nothing about commercial use and does not name the base language model or the SVG-Stack source licences. Audit both before shipping.

hardware.cpu_notes: No CPU route documented; sample code moves the model to CUDA and the vLLM fork targets GPUs. Weights alone are about 15 GB (8B) and 2.9 GB (1B) at 16-bit, by arithmetic from the parameter counts, not a measured VRAM figure.

rea.notes: CVPR 2025. Follow-up RLRF (NeurIPS 2025) is described on the repo but no checkpoints were confirmed.

capabilities.does: Runs VectorFusion and SVGDreamer: a diffusion model scores renders of the vector shapes and the shapes are adjusted to match the prompt. Styles include iconography, pixel art, sketch, low-poly, painting and ink-and-wash.
Runs CLIPDraw and StyleCLIPDraw: strokes are moved until a CLIP model rates the render close to the prompt, optionally with a style reference image.
Runs DiffVG and LIVE image vectorisation. The README says LIVE is meant for PNG emoji-style images.
Runs CLIPasso and CLIPascene: turns a photo or scene into a few strokes. Needs a U2Net download.
Runs DiffSketcher, which makes a sketch from text with adjustable stroke width and opacity.
Runs Word-As-Image and CLIPFont: restyle the outline of letters or a font from a text prompt.

capabilities.does: Vector-graphics rasterisation is made differentiable by pixel prefiltering, in an analytical and a multisampling variant; the multisampling one gives unbiased per-pixel gradients with respect to curve parameters. Examples fit Bezier curves to target images.

In the README section Image vectorization, refine_svg.py is run on an SVG and a target image, with --use_lpips_loss and --num_iter available. The sample command uses flower.svg and flower.jpg; the README does not explain the procedure.
Includes sample apps for a vector VAE and a vector GAN, plus painterly rendering and seam carving.
